description: Manage accounts, contacts, leads and opportunities in Oracle Fusion Cloud Sales.

oracle_fusion_cloud_sales_new_account_tr.description: Runs for each new account in Oracle Fusion Cloud Sales. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.record: object with the fields PartyNumber, OrganizationName, LastUpdateDate, resource_key

oracle_fusion_cloud_sales_new_contact_tr.description: Runs for each new contact in Oracle Fusion Cloud Sales. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.record: object with the fields PartyNumber, FirstName, LastUpdateDate, resource_key, LastName

oracle_fusion_cloud_sales_new_opportunit.description: Runs for each new opportunity in Oracle Fusion Cloud Sales. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.
